The upstream src/wowfish/audio/{features,fingerprint,detector}.py modules were adapted into uu_fishing/detection/. Local changes include stream-clock alignment, validation, reset handling, per-template thresholds and shared refractory arbitration. Window metadata, physical key mapping and Quartz input use ideas from the upstream macOS implementation. Its visual pipeline and installer are not part of this project.

The four unmodified WAVs come from src/wowfish/assets/clips/ at the revision above. They originate from game sounds; the software MIT license does not license Blizzard game audio. No separate WAV redistribution grant was identified. Asset rights remain with their respective owners. Confirm applicable terms or disable the built-ins and provide recordings you have permission to use.
